vision: Open-source, self-hosted indoor cycling training application - a lightweight Zwift alternative without the subscription

target_audience.primary: Serious indoor cyclists who want structured training with their smart trainer without monthly subscription fees
secondary: Privacy-conscious cyclists who prefer self-hosted solutions over cloud-based platforms
Budget-conscious cyclists avoiding Zwift's EUR17.99/month subscription
Tech-savvy developers who appreciate open-source fitness software
Linux/cross-platform users who need native non-Windows cycling software

phases.name: Core Completion
phases.description: Complete existing functionality gaps and technical debt to ensure a polished, fully-functional MVP that delivers on core promises

milestones.title: Export & Sync Complete
milestones.description: Users can export rides to FIT format and sync automatically to Strava

milestones.title: Audio System Complete
milestones.description: Full TTS audio cues and sound effects working during workouts

milestones.title: Integrations Complete
milestones.description: MQTT smart fan and weather integration fully operational

phases.name: Platform Sync & Integration
phases.description: Expand fitness platform integrations to enable seamless data flow to popular training ecosystems

milestones.title: Multi-Platform Sync
milestones.description: Users can sync rides to TrainingPeaks and Garmin Connect in addition to Strava

milestones.title: Enhanced Interactivity
milestones.description: Voice control and improved HID device support for hands-free training

phases.name: Platform Expansion
phases.description: Expand RustRide beyond desktop to mobile and TV platforms for broader accessibility

milestones.title: Mobile Companion Available
milestones.description: Companion app for iOS/Android provides remote control and ride monitoring

milestones.title: Multi-Platform Access
milestones.description: Users can access RustRide from TV apps and web dashboards

phases.name: Advanced Features & Extensibility
phases.description: Add advanced training features, extensibility architecture, and enhanced visual experiences

milestones.title: Plugin Ecosystem Launch
milestones.description: Third-party developers can create and distribute RustRide plugins

milestones.title: Enhanced Training Intelligence
milestones.description: Cloud-connected ML provides advanced personalized training recommendations

milestones.title: Premium Visual Experiences
milestones.description: Real-world video routes and additional 3D environments available

features.title: Complete Strava OAuth Sync
features.description: Finish the Strava OAuth integration to automatically upload completed rides to Strava. This includes proper token refresh handling, background sync, and upload status feedback.
features.rationale: Users want to share rides with their existing Strava community and maintain their activity history. This directly addresses the data lock-in pain point from competitors like Zwift and TrainerRoad where export options are limited.
acceptance_criteria: User can connect Strava account via OAuth flow
Rides automatically upload to Strava after completion
OAuth tokens refresh automatically when expired
Upload status is shown in ride history
Failed uploads can be retried manually
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want my rides to automatically sync to Strava so that I can share my activities with my community
As a user, I want to see upload status so that I know my ride was successfully synced

features.title: FIT File Export
features.description: Add FIT file format export alongside existing TCX and CSV formats. FIT is the industry standard for Garmin devices and provides better compatibility with fitness platforms.
features.rationale: FIT format is the gold standard for fitness data interchange. Adding this export option ensures maximum compatibility with Garmin Connect, TrainingPeaks, and other platforms, reinforcing RustRide's data portability advantage over locked-in competitors.
acceptance_criteria: Export menu includes FIT format option
FIT files contain all ride data (power, HR, cadence, GPS if available)
Exported FIT files validate with Garmin's FIT SDK validator
FIT files upload successfully to Garmin Connect
Lap markers and workout structure preserved in FIT export
user_stories: As a Garmin user, I want to export my rides as FIT files so that I can upload them to Garmin Connect
As a coach, I want FIT exports so that I can analyze rides in professional analysis software

features.title: Complete Text-to-Speech Integration
features.description: Finish the TTS module implementation to provide voice announcements during workouts. This includes interval changes, target power callouts, motivational cues, and customizable voice settings.
features.rationale: Audio cues are essential for focused training where looking at the screen isn't practical. This is a core feature for serious training that competitors charge subscription fees for.
acceptance_criteria: TTS announces interval changes during workouts
Target power/cadence callouts work correctly
User can select from available system voices
Speech rate and volume are configurable
TTS works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
user_stories: As a cyclist doing intervals, I want voice callouts so that I know when to increase or decrease effort without looking at the screen
As a user, I want to customize the voice settings so that the announcements suit my preferences

features.title: Complete Audio Engine
features.description: Finish the audio engine implementation using rodio for sound effects, audio cues, and background audio during rides. Includes countdown sounds, achievement chimes, and optional workout music playback.
features.rationale: Audio feedback enhances the training experience and provides important cues during intense efforts. A polished audio experience differentiates RustRide as a complete training solution.
acceptance_criteria: Countdown sounds play before interval changes
Achievement and milestone chimes work
Audio volume controls function correctly
Audio engine initializes reliably on all platforms
No audio lag or synchronization issues
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want audio countdown before intervals so that I can prepare for effort changes
As a user, I want sound effects for achievements so that my accomplishments feel rewarding

features.title: Complete MQTT Smart Fan Control
features.description: Finish the MQTT client implementation for smart fan integration. Fans should automatically adjust speed based on power output, heart rate, or manual control.
features.rationale: Smart fan integration improves training comfort and is a differentiating feature for a comprehensive training setup. Most competitors don't offer this level of home automation integration.
acceptance_criteria: MQTT connection to broker works reliably
Fan speed adjusts based on configured trigger (power/HR)
Manual fan control override available
Reconnection on connection loss
Clear setup documentation for common smart fan setups
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want my smart fan to speed up when I'm working hard so that I stay cool without manual adjustment
As a user with home automation, I want MQTT integration so that RustRide works with my existing setup

features.title: Weather API Integration
features.description: Complete the weather provider HTTP implementation to fetch real weather data for dynamic weather effects in the 3D world. Weather should match local conditions or be configurable.
features.rationale: Dynamic weather adds immersion to the 3D riding experience. This visual polish differentiates RustRide from bare-bones training apps like TrainerRoad.
acceptance_criteria: Weather data fetches from OpenWeatherMap API
3D world weather matches fetched conditions
Fallback to default weather if API unavailable
Weather can be manually overridden
Minimal battery/data impact from weather requests
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want the virtual world weather to match my local conditions so that training feels more connected to reality
As a user without internet, I want weather to default gracefully so that my training isn't interrupted

features.title: Complete HID Device Support
features.description: Finish HID device enumeration and control for Stream Deck and USB button controllers. Enable configurable button mappings for workout control without touching keyboard/mouse.
features.rationale: HID device support enables hands-free training control, improving the workout experience especially during intense intervals when reaching for controls is impractical.
acceptance_criteria: Stream Deck devices are detected and connected
Button presses trigger configured actions (pause, lap, skip interval)
Button mappings are user-configurable
Works with common USB button controllers
Device reconnects automatically if unplugged/replugged
user_stories: As a cyclist with a Stream Deck, I want to control my workout with physical buttons so that I don't need to reach for my computer
As a user, I want to customize button mappings so that they match my preferred workflow

features.title: TrainingPeaks Sync
features.description: Add TrainingPeaks OAuth integration for uploading completed rides and downloading structured workout plans. Support both manual and automatic sync options.
features.rationale: TrainingPeaks is widely used by coached athletes and provides advanced training analytics. Supporting TrainingPeaks sync makes RustRide viable for serious athletes working with coaches, competing directly with TrainerRoad's value proposition.
acceptance_criteria: User can connect TrainingPeaks account via OAuth
Completed rides upload to TrainingPeaks
Workout plans can be downloaded from TrainingPeaks
Downloaded workouts appear in workout library
Sync status shown in UI
user_stories: As a coached athlete, I want my rides to sync to TrainingPeaks so that my coach can see my training
As a TrainingPeaks user, I want to download my workout plans so that I can execute them in RustRide

features.title: Garmin Connect Sync
features.description: Add Garmin Connect API integration for uploading completed rides. Support automatic background sync to ensure rides are always backed up to Garmin's ecosystem.
features.rationale: Garmin has a massive ecosystem of users who track all activities in Garmin Connect. Native sync makes RustRide seamlessly integrate into their existing training workflow.
acceptance_criteria: User can connect Garmin Connect account
Rides upload to Garmin Connect automatically
FIT files upload correctly with all data preserved
Connection status visible in settings
Failed uploads queue for retry
user_stories: As a Garmin user, I want my indoor rides in Garmin Connect alongside my outdoor rides so that my training history is complete
As a cyclist, I want automatic sync so that I don't have to manually export and upload files

features.title: Voice Control
features.description: Implement voice control using Vosk speech recognition for hands-free workout control. Support commands like 'pause', 'resume', 'skip interval', 'end workout', and 'take lap'.
features.rationale: Voice control enables completely hands-free training, improving safety and convenience during intense efforts. This advanced feature isn't commonly available in competitor products.
acceptance_criteria: Vosk speech model downloads and initializes
Basic workout commands recognized accurately
Wake word or push-to-talk activation
Works offline without cloud processing
Voice command feedback confirms recognition
user_stories: As a cyclist mid-workout, I want to control my session with voice so that I don't have to stop pedaling to reach controls
As a privacy-conscious user, I want voice recognition to work offline so that my speech isn't sent to the cloud

features.title: Enhanced Bluetooth/ANT+ Reliability
features.description: Improve sensor connection reliability with automatic reconnection, connection quality monitoring, and multi-sensor management. Reduce sensor discovery time and handle disconnections gracefully.
features.rationale: Reliable sensor connectivity is fundamental to a good training experience. Connection issues are frustrating and can ruin a workout. Improvement here directly supports the success metric of connecting in under 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Sensor discovery completes in under 30 seconds
Automatic reconnection on temporary disconnection
Connection quality indicator in UI
Graceful handling of sensor conflicts
Improved power meter pairing consistency
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want my sensors to connect quickly so that I can start my workout without delays
As a user with multiple sensors, I want reliable connections so that I don't lose data mid-ride

features.title: Mobile Companion App
features.description: Create a mobile app (iOS/Android) for remote workout control, real-time metrics viewing, and ride history access. Connect to the desktop app over local network.
features.rationale: A mobile companion enables users to mount their phone near the trainer for easy control while keeping the main app on a separate screen. This addresses the gap of no mobile app and improves the overall training experience.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile app connects to desktop app over LAN
Real-time metrics display (power, HR, cadence)
Basic workout controls (pause, resume, skip)
View ride history and statistics
Works on iOS and Android
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want to control my workout from my phone so that I have easy access to controls
As a user with a TV display, I want to use my phone for control while the main screen shows the 3D world

features.title: Apple TV App
features.description: Develop an Apple TV app for big-screen training experience. Connect to sensors directly or pair with desktop/mobile as a remote display.
features.rationale: Apple TV is popular for indoor training setups. Having a native app enables users to train on their TV without needing a computer. This directly addresses the known gap and competes with Zwift's Apple TV presence.
acceptance_criteria: Apple TV app available on App Store
Connects to BLE sensors directly
Full workout execution capability
3D world rendering at 1080p/4K
Siri Remote controls for basic navigation
user_stories: As a cyclist with an Apple TV, I want to train on my big screen so that I have an immersive experience
As a user without a dedicated training PC, I want to use my Apple TV so that I don't need extra hardware

features.title: Web Dashboard
features.description: Create a web-based dashboard for viewing training statistics, ride history, and progress charts. Runs locally on the same machine or network.
features.rationale: A web dashboard enables viewing training data from any device on the network. This is valuable for post-ride analysis and sharing progress, maintaining the self-hosted philosophy.
acceptance_criteria: Web server runs locally on configurable port
Dashboard shows ride history and statistics
Power Duration Curve and fitness charts
Responsive design for mobile/tablet access
Optional authentication for network access
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want to view my training stats on my tablet so that I can analyze my progress anywhere
As a power user, I want a web interface so that I can access data without launching the full app

features.title: Workout Library Expansion
features.description: Expand the built-in workout library with a comprehensive collection of structured workouts for various training goals: endurance, threshold, VO2max, sprint, recovery, and complete training plans.
features.rationale: A rich workout library is essential for users without coaching or TrainingPeaks subscriptions. This provides out-of-the-box value and reduces the need for third-party workout plans.
acceptance_criteria: At least 50 built-in workouts across categories
Workouts organized by type and difficulty
Complete 8-week training plans available
Workout descriptions explain purpose and benefits
Easy filtering and search in workout browser
user_stories: As a new cyclist, I want built-in workouts so that I can start structured training immediately
As a self-coached athlete, I want training plans so that I can follow a progression without paying for coaching

features.title: Plugin/Extension Architecture
features.description: Design and implement a plugin system allowing third-party extensions. Support hooks for sensor integrations, export formats, training metrics, and UI customizations.
features.rationale: An extension architecture enables community contributions and specialized integrations without bloating the core application. This differentiates RustRide as an open, extensible platform.
acceptance_criteria: Plugin API documented and stable
Plugins can add custom export formats
Plugins can add new sensor protocols
Plugin manager for install/enable/disable
Example plugins demonstrate capabilities
user_stories: As a developer, I want to create plugins so that I can add features specific to my needs
As a user with niche hardware, I want plugin support so that community developers can add compatibility

features.title: Cloud ML API Integration
features.description: Complete the cloud ML API backend for enhanced training recommendations. Optionally upload anonymized training data for improved fatigue detection and workout suggestions.
features.rationale: Cloud ML can provide more sophisticated training recommendations than local inference alone. This is opt-in to respect privacy while offering advanced features for users who want them.
acceptance_criteria: Cloud API endpoint configurable (self-hosted option)
Anonymized data upload with user consent
Enhanced workout recommendations from ML models
Fallback to local inference if cloud unavailable
Clear privacy policy and data handling documentation
user_stories: As a data-positive athlete, I want cloud ML analysis so that I get the best possible training recommendations
As a privacy-conscious user, I want this to be optional so that I can choose local-only processing

features.title: Advanced Training Analytics
features.description: Add advanced analytics including Polarized Training Index, Training Readiness Score, long-term periodization tracking, and comparison with historical seasons.
features.rationale: Advanced analytics help serious athletes optimize their training and track long-term progress. These features compete with TrainingPeaks and WKO5 premium analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Polarized Training Index calculated and displayed
Training Readiness Score based on recent load
Season comparison charts
Periodization calendar with planned phases
Export analytics to PDF reports
user_stories: As a serious athlete, I want advanced analytics so that I can optimize my training periodization
As a self-coached cyclist, I want readiness scores so that I know when to push or recover

features.title: Real-World Route Video Playback
features.description: Add support for playing synced real-world route videos during rides. Match video playback speed to cycling speed and support common video formats.
features.rationale: Route videos provide an alternative visual experience to 3D worlds. This feature competes with Rouvy and Fulgaz while supporting user-sourced content.
acceptance_criteria: Import route videos with GPX sync points
Video speed matches cycling speed
Support for common formats (MP4, MKV)
Gradient data extracted from video metadata
Smooth video playback without stuttering
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want to ride route videos so that I can experience famous climbs virtually
As a user with my own video content, I want to import it so that I can relive past rides

features.title: Additional 3D Environments
features.description: Create additional 3D world environments beyond the current coastal, countryside, and mountain themes. Add urban, desert, forest, and fantasy environments.
features.rationale: Environment variety keeps training engaging over time. New environments provide reasons to return and explore, enhancing the visual experience that differentiates RustRide from bare-bones trainers.
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 new environment themes available
Each environment has unique visual style and landmarks
Performance remains within target (<200MB, <10% CPU)
Environment selection in ride setup screen
Procedural variations for each environment type
user_stories: As a cyclist, I want different environments so that training stays visually interesting
As a long-term user, I want new content so that the experience stays fresh
